en.tagline: Grab snapshots, clips and motion events from cameras
en.summary: camsnap captures still frames, short clips, and motion events from RTSP and ONVIF cameras. You register each camera once with a name and login, then refer to it by that name in commands. It is a command line tool that an agent or script can call to get camera output.
problem: Getting a frame or a short video from a network camera usually means looking up its stream address and login, then running a media tool with the right options. Each camera needs its own setup.
With camsnap, each camera is saved under a name in a config file. Commands such as snap, clip, and watch take that name, so the caller does not need the stream details each time.
fit: Saving a still image from a named camera
Recording a short clip from a camera for review
Running a command when motion passes a set threshold
unfit: Cameras that do not offer RTSP or ONVIF
Environments where ffmpeg cannot be put on the PATH
steps: Add each camera with `camsnap add`, giving it a name, host, user and password. The entry is stored in `~/.config/camsnap/config.yaml`.
Find cameras on the network with `camsnap discover --info`.
Take a still image from a named camera with `camsnap snap <name> --out <file>`.
Record a clip of a set length with `camsnap clip <name> --dur <time> --out <file>`.
Watch for motion with `camsnap watch <name> --threshold <value> --action '<command>'`, which runs the action when motion is detected.
Check the setup with `camsnap doctor --probe`. Start with a short test capture before longer clips.

zh.tagline: 从摄像头抓取截图、视频片段和移动事件
zh.summary: camsnap 可从 RTSP 和 ONVIF 摄像头抓取静态画面、短视频片段和移动事件。每个摄像头只需添加一次，并设置名称和登录信息，之后命令中直接使用该名称即可。它是一个命令行工具，智能体或脚本可以调用它获取摄像头输出。
problem: 要从网络摄像头取得一帧画面或一段短视频，通常需要先查到视频流地址和登录信息，再用正确的参数运行媒体工具。每台摄像头都要单独设置。
使用 camsnap 后，每台摄像头以名称保存在配置文件中。snap、clip、watch 等命令只需传入该名称，调用方每次都无需再提供视频流细节。
fit: 从指定摄像头保存静态图片
录制一段短视频用于回看
检测到移动达到设定阈值时执行一条命令
unfit: 不支持 RTSP 或 ONVIF 的摄像头
无法将 ffmpeg 加入 PATH 的环境
steps: 用 `camsnap add` 添加每台摄像头，填写名称、主机地址、用户名和密码。条目保存在 `~/.config/camsnap/config.yaml` 中。
用 `camsnap discover --info` 查找网络中的摄像头。
用 `camsnap snap <名称> --out <文件>` 从指定摄像头截取一张静态图片。
用 `camsnap clip <名称> --dur <时长> --out <文件>` 录制指定时长的视频片段。
用 `camsnap watch <名称> --threshold <阈值> --action '<命令>'` 监测移动，检测到移动时执行该命令。
用 `camsnap doctor --probe` 检查配置。录制较长片段前，先做一次简短的测试抓取。
